primitives.name: Template Asset Generation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Operator can: - **Select one or more templates** and click "Generate selected." Triggers Claude API calls in parallel (subject to cost budget).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'template index, dimensionless', 'C': 'Claude API call cost, USD', 'B': 'budget limit, USD', 'G': 'generated asset, markdown/text'}
primitives.assumptions: API calls are independent and bounded by cost constraint B.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When sum of C(T) > B, generation halts.

layer2.mapping: Asset generation kernel maps template selection T to output G under cost constraint C(B).
layer2.telemetry: Number of successful API calls and total cost incurred.

primitives.name: Compliance Flagging
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Compliance flags panel (right rail) When an asset is generated: - Compliance scanner result rendered with the offending spans highlighted.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': 'flag status, {not generated, green, yellow, red}', 'R': 'rule triggering flag, string', 'S': 'suggested fix, string'}
primitives.assumptions: Each flag F is a deterministic function of content and rule set R.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F = red, export is blocked.

layer2.mapping: Flagging system is isomorphic to a binary classifier over content risk manifold.
layer2.telemetry: Count of red flags per asset and rule violation types.

primitives.name: Generation History
primitives.verbatim_quote: For each generated asset, a row: - Template name + timestamp. - Status badge. - "Restore" button to roll back to a prior version. - "Diff" button to compare two versions side-by-side. History entries are immutable.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H': 'history entry, tuple (template, time, status)', 'V': 'version identifier, integer', 'M': 'immutable log, sequence of H'}
primitives.assumptions: History M is append-only and versioned by V.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Version conflict arises if V is reused.

layer2.mapping: History kernel preserves state transitions of asset versions under immutability constraint.
layer2.telemetry: Total number of history entries and diff operations performed.

The generator is constrained by a cost budget B, modeled as a resource allocation problem where each template T incurs a cost C(T). The compliance layer acts as a risk manifold, where flag status F determines whether an asset G can proceed to export. The history layer ensures temporal consistency via immutable logs M. The lens toggle introduces a contextual bias in template emphasis, affecting the conditional probability P(G|L) where L is the lens state. Failure modes include exceeding B (budget overflow), F=red (compliance block), and version collision in M (immutability violation).
